module: Flowgraph node "Set Button Property" (category repeat_instant): modifies the properties of an existing button. Inputs: "buttonId", "label", "active", "order", "style". Only the properties whose pin has a non-nil value are applied (module button:set).

postInit.desc: Defines the value template of the style pin.

work.desc: If the button exists, applies active/order/style/label whose pins are not nil.
